summary: First Capital, Inc. filed an 8-K on November 4, 2026 disclosing a definitive Agreement and Plan of Merger under which First Bancorp of Indiana, Inc. will merge into First Capital, with First Federal Savings Bank merging into First Harrison Bank. Consideration is 0.3075 First Capital shares per First Bancorp share, a fixed exchange ratio, valuing the deal at approximately $33.2 million based on First Capital's 20-day VWAP of $63.05 as of November 4, 2026. Cash is paid in lieu of fractional shares. First Bancorp's board will recommend approval and solicit proxies; no advisor is named. What to watch: shareholder and regulatory approvals, plus arbitrage sensitivity to First Capital's share price given the fixed ratio.
